description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack - Delusive Dive

When Cantarella has Trance, Heavy Attack becomes Delusive Dive, dealing Havoc DMG to the target, and then Cantarella enters Mirage. While in Mirage, casting Delusive Dive does not activate Mirage again.
Can be cast in water.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack - Delusive Dive

Saat Cantarella memiliki Trance, Heavy Attack menjadi Delusive Dive, memberikan Havoc DMG ke target, lalu Cantarella memasuki Mirage. Saat berada di Mirage, menggunakan Delusive Dive tidak mengaktifkan Mirage lagi.
Dapat dilakukan di air.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

description.en:
Graceful Step

Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.

Flickering Reverie

When in Mirage, Resonance Skill becomes Flickering Reverie, which is considered an Echo Skill when being cast. Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, and send them into Hazy Dream.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Hazy Dream

Reduce the target's movement speed for 6.5s. When the target takes damage, Jolt is triggered once, removing Hazy Dream to deal Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Attacks by other Resonators in the team will not Jolt a target influenced by Hazy Dream and will remove the Hazy Dream.
Coordinated Attacks and damage from Utilities will not Jolt a target.
description.id:
Graceful Step

Menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Flickering Reverie

Saat di Mirage, Resonance Skill menjadi Flickering Reverie, yang dianggap sebagai Echo Skill saat digunakan. Menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG, dan menjerumuskannya ke Hazy Dream.
Dapat dilakukan di udara.

Hazy Dream

Mengurangi kecepatan gerak target selama 6,5 dtk. Saat target menerima damage, Jolt terpicu sekali, menghapus Hazy Dream untuk memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
Serangan Resonator lain dalam tim tidak akan memicu Jolt pada target yang terkena Hazy Dream dan akan menghapus Hazy Dream.
Coordinated Attack dan damage dari Utilities tidak akan memicu Jolt pada target.

description.en:
Flowing Suffocation

Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG). Grant Diffusion to all Resonators in the team. Casting this skill is also considered as casting Echo Skill.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Diffusion

When the Resonator on the field deals damage to a target, summon Dreamweavers to perform Coordinated Attack, dealing Havoc DMG (considered as Basic Attack DMG).
- Within 3s after the Resonator deals damage, summon 1 Dreamweavers per second. This effect can be triggered once per second. Damage dealt by Dreamweavers cannot trigger this effect.
- Up to 1 Dreamweavers can be summoned each second, max 21 Dreamweavers in total.
- This effect lasts for 30s or until reaching the maximum number of Dreamweavers.
description.id:
Flowing Suffocation

Menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG (dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG). Memberikan Diffusion ke semua Resonator dalam tim. Menggunakan skill ini juga dianggap sebagai menggunakan Echo Skill.
Dapat dilakukan di udara saat dekat dengan tanah.

Diffusion

Saat Resonator yang sedang di lapangan memberikan damage ke target, memanggil Dreamweavers untuk melakukan Coordinated Attack, memberikan Havoc DMG (dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG).
- Dalam 3 dtk setelah Resonator memberikan damage, memanggil 1 Dreamweavers per detik. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali per detik. Damage dari Dreamweavers tidak dapat memicu efek ini.
- Hingga 1 Dreamweavers dapat dipanggil setiap detik, maksimal 21 Dreamweavers secara total.
- Efek ini berlangsung selama 30 dtk atau hingga jumlah maksimum Dreamweavers tercapai.

description.en: Casting Echo Skill gives 6% Havoc DMG Bonus for 10s, stacking up to 2 times.
description.id: Menggunakan Echo Skill memberi 6% Havoc DMG Bonus selama 10 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 2 kali.

description.en:
Ripple

Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to start the Basic Attack combo from Basic Attack Stage 3.

Tidal Surge

When in Mirage, Intro Skill becomes Tidal Surge, which triggers 3 coordinated attacks on hit, dealing Havoc DMG. Casting Tidal Surge resets the combo of Basic Attack Phantom Sting.
description.id:
Ripple

Menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk memulai kombo Basic Attack dari Basic Attack Tahap 3.

Tidal Surge

Saat di Mirage, Intro Skill menjadi Tidal Surge, yang memicu 3 Coordinated Attack saat mengenai target, memberikan Havoc DMG. Menggunakan Tidal Surge mengatur ulang kombo Basic Attack Phantom Sting.

description.en:
Mirage

- Basic Attack becomes Basic Attack Phantom Sting. Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. Can be cast in mid-air. When cast mid-air, Basic Attack Phantom Sting consumes STA, and the combo does not reset when Cantarella is airborne.
- Hitting the target with Basic Attack Phantom Sting consumes 1 point of Trance to obtain 1 point of Shiver and heal all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The third stage of Basic Attack Phantom Sting triggers 3 Coordinated Attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
- Mid-air Attack becomes Abysmal Vortex. Press Jump to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Havoc DMG.
- Dodge Counter becomes Dodge Counter Shadowy Sweep. Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack right after casting the skill to cast Basic Attack Phantom Sting Stage 2.
- When Mid-air Attack Abysmal Vortex or Dodge Counter Shadowy Sweep hits a target, consume 1 point of Trance to obtain 1 point of Shiver and heal all nearby Resonators in the team.
- Mirage lasts for 8s.
- Mirage ends when Trance is depleted.

Forte Circuit - Perception Drain

If Cantarella has 3 points of Shiver when in Mirage, Resonance Skill becomes Perception Drain.
Consume all Shiver to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. Send the target into Hazy Dream and heal all Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill is also considered as casting Echo Skill.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Abyssal Rebirth

After casting Intro Skill, Cantarella enters Abyssal Rebirth, which lasts for 25s and can be activated once every 25s. In the duration, for up to 6 times, when Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Cantarella recovers 6 points of Concerto Energy. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.
When in water, Cantarella's swimming speed increases and STA cost decreases.

Trance

- Cantarella can hold up to 5 points of Trance.
- Casting Intro Skill recovers 1 point of Trance.
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack Stage 3 recovers 1 point of Trance.
- Casting Resonance Skill Graceful Step recovers 1 point of Trance.
- Casting Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation recovers 3 points of Trance.
- When in the water, recover 1 point of Trance every 5s.

Shiver

- Cantarella can hold up to 3 points of Shiver.
- Hitting the target with Basic Attack Phantom Sting recovers 1 point of Shiver.
- When Mid-air Attack Abysmal Vortex or Dodge Counter Shadowy Sweep hits a target, restore 1 point of Shiver.
description.id:
Mirage

- Basic Attack menjadi Basic Attack Phantom Sting. Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG. Dapat dilakukan di udara. Saat dilakukan di udara, Basic Attack Phantom Sting mengonsumsi STA, dan kombo tidak diatur ulang saat Cantarella melayang di udara.
- Mengenai target dengan Basic Attack Phantom Sting mengonsumsi 1 poin Trance untuk mendapat 1 poin Shiver dan memulihkan HP semua Resonator di sekitar dalam tim.
- Tahap ketiga Basic Attack Phantom Sting memicu 3 Coordinated Attack, memberikan Havoc DMG.
- Mid-air Attack menjadi Abysmal Vortex. Tekan Jump untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Havoc DMG.
- Dodge Counter menjadi Dodge Counter Shadowy Sweep. Menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG. Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah menggunakan skill untuk melakukan Basic Attack Phantom Sting Tahap 2.
- Saat Mid-air Attack Abysmal Vortex atau Dodge Counter Shadowy Sweep mengenai target, mengonsumsi 1 poin Trance untuk mendapat 1 poin Shiver dan memulihkan HP semua Resonator di sekitar dalam tim.
- Mirage berlangsung selama 8 dtk.
- Mirage berakhir saat Trance habis.

Forte Circuit - Perception Drain

Jika Cantarella memiliki 3 poin Shiver saat di Mirage, Resonance Skill menjadi Perception Drain.
Mengonsumsi seluruh Shiver untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Menjerumuskan target ke Hazy Dream dan memulihkan HP semua Resonator dalam tim.
Menggunakan skill ini juga dianggap sebagai menggunakan Echo Skill.
Dapat dilakukan di udara.

Abyssal Rebirth

Setelah menggunakan Intro Skill, Cantarella memasuki Abyssal Rebirth, yang berlangsung selama 25 dtk dan dapat diaktifkan sekali setiap 25 dtk. Selama durasi tersebut, hingga 6 kali, saat Resonator dalam tim menggunakan Echo Skill, Cantarella memulihkan 6 poin Concerto Energy. Echo dengan nama yang sama hanya dapat memicu efek ini sekali.
Saat di air, kecepatan berenang Cantarella meningkat dan biaya STA berkurang.

Trance

- Cantarella dapat menyimpan hingga 5 poin Trance.
- Menggunakan Intro Skill memulihkan 1 poin Trance.
- Mengenai target dengan Basic Attack Tahap 3 memulihkan 1 poin Trance.
- Menggunakan Resonance Skill Graceful Step memulihkan 1 poin Trance.
- Menggunakan Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation memulihkan 3 poin Trance.
- Saat di air, memulihkan 1 poin Trance setiap 5 dtk.

Shiver

- Cantarella dapat menyimpan hingga 3 poin Shiver.
- Mengenai target dengan Basic Attack Phantom Sting memulihkan 1 poin Shiver.
- Saat Mid-air Attack Abysmal Vortex atau Dodge Counter Shadowy Sweep mengenai target, memulihkan 1 poin Shiver.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Amplify the incoming Resonator's Havoc DMG by 20% and Resonance Skill DMG by 25% for 14s. Switching Resonators ends this effect.
description.id: Amplify Havoc DMG Resonator yang masuk sebesar 20% dan Resonance Skill DMG sebesar 25% selama 14 dtk. Mengganti Resonator mengakhiri efek ini.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melakukan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Casting Resonance Skill recovers 1 points of Trance. The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Graceful Step, Resonance Skill Flickering Reverie, and Forte Circuit Perception Drain is increased by 50%. Immune to interruptions while casting Perception Drain.
description.id: Menggunakan Resonance Skill memulihkan 1 poin Trance. Pengali DMG Resonance Skill Graceful Step, Resonance Skill Flickering Reverie, dan Forte Circuit Perception Drain meningkat sebesar 50%. Kebal terhadap interupsi saat menggunakan Perception Drain.

description.en: Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation now sends the target into Hazy Dream. The DMG Multiplier of Jolt triggered by Cantarella is increased by 245%.
description.id: Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation kini menjerumuskan target ke Hazy Dream. Pengali DMG Jolt yang dipicu Cantarella meningkat sebesar 245%.

description.en: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation is increased by 370%. After casting Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation, enter into Mirage. If already in Mirage, casting Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation does not activate the Mirage state again.
description.id: Pengali DMG Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation meningkat sebesar 370%. Setelah menggunakan Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation, memasuki Mirage. Jika sudah di Mirage, menggunakan Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation tidak mengaktifkan kondisi Mirage lagi.

description.en: When in Mirage, Healing Bonus is increased by 25%.
description.id: Saat di Mirage, Healing Bonus meningkat sebesar 25%.

description.en: The maximum number of Dreamweavers Cantarella can summon through Resonance Liberation Diffusion is increased by 5.
description.id: Jumlah maksimum Dreamweavers yang dapat dipanggil Cantarella melalui Resonance Liberation Diffusion meningkat sebesar 5.

sequences.name: Fall, Fall... and Fall Deeper into the Dream

description.en:
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack Phantom Sting by 80%. Casting Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation makes Cantarella's DMG ignore 30% of the target's DEF for 10s.
For the first 1.2s of Hazy Dream, when the target takes an instance of DMG that does not inflict Hazy Dream, Jolt will not be triggered on the target.
description.id:
Meningkatkan Pengali DMG Basic Attack Phantom Sting sebesar 80%. Menggunakan Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation membuat DMG Cantarella mengabaikan 30% DEF target selama 10 dtk.
Selama 1,2 dtk pertama Hazy Dream, saat target menerima satu instans DMG yang tidak menimbulkan Hazy Dream, Jolt tidak akan terpicu pada target.
